props.subtitle: The community corpus went fully green for the first time — and the blocking-flip clock is now at 2 of 5 clean ticks
props.meta: 2026-07-03 · leviathan main · commits cac07638a → 2f0eb36ea, all pushed

props.content: Intent-conservation is an advisory evaluator that grades whether the prompt actually delivered to an agent still matches the operator's sealed intent. Before it is allowed to block runs, it must survive a soak: five consecutive dual-suite recerts with zero false seals. This session opened that ledger, cured the last two red examples in the corpus, and landed the multi-node grading the flip requires.

props.label: OPEN THREADS
props.title: Three decisions waiting on their turn
props.subtitle: Explained, not yet executed — each is one bounded dispatch or ruling

props.title: 🧩 lev-zi6v — project-override red
props.content: One flowmind pentagon scenario proves the config cascade: init a throwaway project, apply a project-local core-loop override, assert it resolves as the proof-bearing default. It fails at run.ts:113 — pre-existing, not an eval case, but it runs first in all-scenarios mode so the full pentagon can't complete. Likely the same 'example lags a platform cutover' class as the two reds just cured; risk is it exposes a genuine config-apply regression instead.

props.title: 🚪 lev-isc9 — escape hatch design
props.content: Before conservation can block, there must be a sanctioned way to un-block a run sealed drifted incorrectly — otherwise the first false seal in production halts a pipeline with no remedy but reverting the whole flip. Open questions: what the override looks like (attestation, flow-level downgrade, signed waiver), ownership (core/eval only — one-brain doctrine), and audit (an override seals its own receipt so the soak ledger can count them as threshold-miscalibration evidence).

props.title: 🃏 lev-odm8 — shell-proof registration
props.content: The pentagon examples use a synthetic shell-proof adapter registered by two mutually-inconsistent root-local compat declarations, while a proper provider card sits unwired at plugins/platforms. execution-binding rejects root-vs-compat conflicts, so this is a latent trap. The ruling: promote the card and delete both compat declarations (hard-cutover style), or bless root-local compat for synthetic adapters and delete the card. Poly owns the contract, so it wants a deliberate ruling.

props.title: Deterministic code
props.content: core/exec gate-expression.ts (&& conjunctions) and intent-conservation-proof.ts (multi-node grading) plus two example-side pentagon files. All verdicts remain deterministic — observer and sensor companions decide; no LLM decides anything in this path.

props.title: DNA / YAML / .lev
props.content: Soak ledger and handoff only. No gate policies, no thresholds, no flow contracts touched. Conservation stays advisory everywhere — the flip remains governed by the six lev-isc9 gates.
